Rift, a fast file manager for Windows with tabs and side-by-side panes. This release is about staying responsive:
in huge folders and on drives that are slow to answer.

## Download

Unzip `rift-0.8.0-win-x64.zip` anywhere and run `Rift.exe`. Windows 10 or 11, x64; no .NET install needed.
The exe isn't signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn on the first start: "More info" → "Run anyway".

## New in 0.8

- A folder with 100,000 files opens without freezing the window: reading and sorting run in the background
- Type-to-filter in such a folder answers in about 70 ms instead of 0.8 s
- Ctrl+A in 100,000 files and then a click no longer hangs for seconds; memory with that folder open is less than half
- A network drive that's asleep no longer holds up the start or This PC: it shows by its letter until it answers
- A folder that's slow to read shows the busy bar instead of the previous folder's files
- Typed paths (address bar, Ctrl+K) are checked in the background, so an unreachable `\\server\share` doesn't freeze anything
- Drives in the sidebar and This PC follow USB sticks and cards as they're plugged in and pulled out

See [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/keyldev/rift/blob/main/ROADMAP.md) for what's next.
